metadata.hardware_requirements: NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU and Intel Xeon CPU E5-1650 ('computing server with NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU and Intel Xeon CPU E5-1650 (3.6 GHz, 6 cores)')

nodes_source.source_quote: The data used to support the results of this study are available from the corresponding author upon request.
nodes_source.description: Empirical traffic data from a freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao in Shandong, China, used to calibrate simulation parameters and traffic volumes.
nodes_source.reproducibility_rationale: The paper explicitly states in the Data Availability section that the data is available upon request from the corresponding author. No URL or DOI is provided.

nodes_process.node_name: Traffic Video Preprocessing and State Representation
nodes_process.source_quote: Three consecutive frames of the traffic video in the controlled area are needed as the observation input... After zooming and down-sampling, the size of one observation is 4 x 512 in pixels.
nodes_process.description: Vehicle locations are extracted from raw video frames to reconstruct visual representations. The images are zoomed, down-sampled to 4x512 pixels, and three consecutive frames are stacked to form the state matrix.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, tools implied but no specific library named, all key parameters stated.

nodes_process.source_quote: The reward rt after action at is defined by the following: rt = mu vt + omega qt, mu > 0, omega < 0
nodes_process.description: Defines the reinforcement learning reward as a weighted sum of the average speed in the merging area and the average queue length at the on-ramp.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, mathematical formulation is exact, all required parameters are provided.

nodes_process.source_quote: consists of three convolutional neural network (CNN) layers and one full connection (FC) layer for each output layer.
nodes_process.description: Initializes a deep neural network for multitask learning. It uses 3 CNN layers to extract features and 2 FC layers to predict the Q-value, mean speed, and queue length simultaneously.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, architecture fully detailed in Figure 7, though specific deep learning framework is not named.

nodes_process.source_quote: The Q-network is trained in 10^6 training frames... The training process... can be finished in less than 24 hours on a computing server with NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU
nodes_process.description: Trains the Q-network using the Adam optimizer, experience replay, and a target network. An epsilon-greedy strategy is used for exploration.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, all hyperparameters are explicitly listed in Table 1, optimizer named.

nodes_process.source_quote: The proposed method is evaluated in SUMO, an open-source microscopic traffic simulator. The simulation is performed in the freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao
nodes_process.description: Configures the SUMO traffic simulator using real-world empirical data. Implements two baselines for comparison: a no-control scenario and the PI-ALINEA ramp metering method.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, simulator named, all PI-ALINEA regulator parameters and speed limits stated.

nodes_process.source_quote: each scenario is evaluated in 20 simulation experiments. The simulations for the training phase and each experiment are initialized with different random seeds.
nodes_process.description: Evaluates the trained DRL method against the no-control and PI-ALINEA baselines across 20 simulation experiments. Metrics include travel time, speed distribution, queue length, and downstream volume.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, evaluation protocol is clear, number of runs stated.

nodes_process.source_quote: A perturbation analysis is conducted to evaluate the impact of information contained in video data. As shown in Figure 15, the control area is divided into eight subareas.
nodes_process.description: Evaluates the robustness of the DRL model by removing information from specific subareas (out of 8 defined subareas) to generate perturbed data and measuring the impact on travel time.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, perturbation method is described and parameters given, but exact mechanism of 'removing information' is slightly abstract.

nodes_sink.source_quote: The training process, presented in Figure 8, can be finished in less than 24 hours on a computing server
nodes_sink.description: Convergence curves showing episode reward and mean travel time over training frames.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: SUMO simulator and hyperparameters are specified, but specific code and dataset are available only upon request, limiting direct reproducibility.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 9 presents the Q1 (25%), Q2 (50%), and Q3 (75%) of the travel times in the mainline for three scenarios.
nodes_sink.description: Line plot showing the 25th, 50th, and 75th percentiles of vehicle travel times in the mainline over time for no control, PI-ALINEA, and Deep RL.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Relies on SUMO simulation with empirical data. Data is available on request. Method is well-described but lacks open code/data links.
